title: Giraffe wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='42' width='22' height='42' rx='8' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='4.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='51' cy='66' r='3.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='75' r='4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='47' cy='88' rx='28' ry='11' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='87' r='4' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='92' r='4.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='87' r='3.5' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='12' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff9d3d' transform='rotate(-30 30 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='66' cy='12' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#ff9d3d' transform='rotate(30 66 12)'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <rect x='38' y='8' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e0912f'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='8' r='3' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <rect x='54' y='8' width='4' height='10' rx='2' fill='#e0912f'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='8' r='3' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='28' rx='17' ry='15' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='38' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- nostrils -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#b5651d'/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x='33' y='22' width='13' height='9' rx='3.5' fill='#3a2a6d'/>
  <rect x='50' y='22' width='13' height='9' rx='3.5' fill='#3a2a6d'/>
  <rect x='45' y='24' width='4' height='3' fill='#3a2a6d'/>
  <rect x='33' y='22' width='13' height='9' rx='3.5' fill='none' stroke='#8f7ad6' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <rect x='50' y='22' width='13' height='9' rx='3.5' fill='none' stroke='#8f7ad6' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='34.5' y1='25' x2='38' y2='24' stroke='#9d8be0' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='51.5' y1='25' x2='55' y2='24' stroke='#9d8be0' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <rect x='33' y='21' width='13' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a48a8'/>
  <rect x='50' y='21' width='13' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#5a48a8'/>
  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='26' y='93' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <rect x='42' y='95' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <rect x='56' y='95' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <rect x='66' y='92' width='6' height='6' rx='2' fill='#f7c948'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='26' y='96' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <rect x='42' y='98' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <rect x='56' y='98' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b4513'/>
  <rect x='66' y='95' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#8b4513'/>
</svg>
